description: Maho Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Lanes Owned by the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha. It contains detailed schedules of roads with coordinates, lengths, and widths, which falls under land registrations and property ownership matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or electoral matters.
